entry_state: The mathematical chapter now distinguishes compatible histories,conditional transitions,declared laws,numerical enclosures and causal assumptions. Theta is defined before use and remains conditional on the chosen history/scenario/model. Stress paths do not update history weights or grant management future knowledge. The language chapter must carry these meanings into types,records and executable rules.
exit_state: The language now carries exact contextual values,portable record identity,declared compilation scope and restricted posting rules. The debt listing retains the continuous family behind its named endpoints. Alternative readings inherit parent constraints and link shared treatment choices;the handling of revisions continues on page103.
findings: Historical Core0 and the proposed portable profile are explicitly distinguished. The first matched text frontend covers debt while the typed company domain is broader;the compiler cannot silently solve or fill missing financial premises.
Portable encoding specifies exact rationals,Unicode handling,dependency closure and ordered versus sorted arrays. The hash provides representation identity,not source truth or economic equivalence.
The fixed-share alpha versus floating-share x mapping is explicit,and the matched endpoints5/7,midpoint6 and changed upper9 have independent arithmetic checks. The staged code is legible.

Posting rules return proposed batches;negative interest and separate accrual/settlement dates remain outside the example. Rule conflicts and unresolved applicability do not receive file-order tie-breaking. No confirmed new defect;the alternative-update section remains open.
